seal.statement: Every distributed SQL result, including result column names, equals what SQLite returns for the same statement over the union of the partitions' rows in canonical layout (partition key-range ordinal, partition scan order): the coordinator evaluates final projection, aggregate combination, GROUP BY, HAVING, DISTINCT, ORDER BY (collations, NULLs, storage-class order) and LIMIT/OFFSET, cross-partition joins, FROM-less SELECTs and write-key expressions with an in-memory SQLite of the partitions' exact build over typed rows ingested in that layout; row values and parameters keep their NULL/INTEGER(int64)/REAL/TEXT/BLOB storage class across every request, answer and durable hop through one codec and one versioned durable command format; column types and collations reach the coordinator from the one catalog schema through the one DDL renderer owner; and no JavaScript SQL evaluator, comparator, renderer duplicate, affinity classifier or CREATE TABLE parser remains outside the classified routing/codec/presentation owners. Merge resources are owned, bounded (page bounds on main and temp, adaptive per-partition caps, a killable process for coordinator-evaluated work) and refused with typed outcomes, never truncated.
